objective: BOND-DEPTH-20261112-001 direction 1 (G17, with G1), the first study computed by Codex from a frozen spec (the owner's trial of 2026-11-13): for each of the 664 one-definition limit-only families, build the whole reachable state graph of the exact ray-bond DP and prove its long-run behaviour: a minimum cycle mean (Karp) as a proved lower rate when the graph is complete, and boundedness for every depth when an empty-W cycle of acceptable nodes is reachable. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: minimum cycle means and min-plus eventual periodicity are classical (Karp 1978; Cohen, Dubois, Quadrat and Viot); their use to prove growth or boundedness of least bonds in nested NAE patterns is ours.
status: Complete 2026-11-13 (Partially successful; referee pending): along a ray the least bond provably grows linearly in 226 of 664 one-definition limit-only families (1/6 to 2 per level) and is bounded at every depth in 305; P2 (89%) and P3 (72%) failed. Recommendation: Research directions, the true bond with side branches.
stop_rule: One registered run, its frozen summary, a referee hand-off; report and hold.
title: Proved rates for the law's reach along a ray
